# tissue_mast_rotation (Data Source)

An on-call rotation, by id or by name. Useful for pointing a policy at a rotation someone made in the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A rotation made in the app.
data "tissue_mast_rotation" "primary" {
  name = "primary"
}

output "on_call" {
  value = data.tissue_mast_rotation.primary.on_call_user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The rotation id.
- `name` (String) The rotation name. It has to be unique to look it up this way.

### Read-Only

- `handoff` (String)
- `handoff_day` (Number)
- `handoff_time` (String)
- `length_hours` (Number)
- `on_call_until` (String) When that shift ends.
- `on_call_user_id` (String) Who is on call as of the read.
- `order` (List of String)
- `tz` (String)
